analysis: The trial completed successfully but achieved macro validation HR@10 of 0.4600, below the reported parent score of 0.475 and SASRec reference of 0.505. Per-category HR@10 was 0.470 for Movies_and_TV, 0.505 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.385 for Electronics, and 0.480 for CDs_and_Vinyl. The added sequential branch did not improve the aggregate result. Its zero-initialized gate preserves the aggregate-only scoring function initially, but does not guarantee better optimization or generalization. Gate trajectories and ablations are unavailable, so the regression cannot be attributed to a specific mechanism.
code_summary: The model combines candidate-conditioned history aggregation with a gated sequential readout. Two causal Transformer blocks encode item and position embeddings. The aggregation path uses candidate/history compatibility, learned recency buckets, square-root attention normalization, and item bias. The new branch applies LayerNorm–Linear–LayerNorm to the final nonpadding encoder state, scores it against shared candidate embeddings, and adds the result through a zero-initialized tanh scalar gate. Training retains sampled cross-entropy with 16 negatives, AdamW, embedding regularization, history sampling, and all four dataset routes. The predictor writer reconstructs the updated architecture, strictly loads checkpoints, and checks prediction parity.
